_README: The owner's exercise library (#5769). PROPOSED — nothing in the drafting path reads it until the owner approves it. Public half only: no bodyweight, no loads, no note text — the N=1 half (best set per bodyweight band, coded note signals, gate threshold values) is the owner-private overlay s3://matthew-life-platform/config/coaching/exercise_library.private.json, joined at selection time by lambdas/training/exercise_library.py (fail-closed). Built by deploy/build_exercise_library.py from the full Hevy history + deploy/exercise_library_curation.py. Doc: docs/coaching/EXERCISE_LIBRARY.md.

change_log.what: First library: every Hevy template he has logged (full history, tombstones excluded), expansion candidates, attributes, verified-citation hypertrophy tiers, gates defined (evaluated in #5772), gym inventory unconfirmed.
change_log.rule: proposed until the owner approves; any change after approval needs an owner ruling — bump `version`, add a line

_provenance.history_source: DynamoDB life-platform pk=USER#matthew#SOURCE#hevy per-workout rows, every phase (read-only query)
_provenance.attribute_rule: derived by rule unless deploy/exercise_library_curation.py overrides; `unknown` = the rule cannot say

gym_inventory.rule: owner ruling 2026-11-11: equipment used by any movement logged in the last 5 years of Hevy history (on or after 2021-11-10) is `available` at home_gym; equipment seen only in older history or only in expansion candidates is `unknown`; a 'gym doesn't have X' note makes X `unavailable` (owner-confirmable); contention ('X was taken', 'no bench free') never changes a state. The gym is never named.

maeo2023_overhead_triceps.title: Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position
maeo2023_overhead_triceps.authors: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, Sakurai H, Kusagawa Y, Sugiyama T, Kanehisa H, Isaka T
maeo2023_overhead_triceps.design: within-subject RCT, cable elbow extension, 12 wk, MRI muscle volume
maeo2023_overhead_triceps.finding: overhead arm position grew the long head ~1.5x and the whole triceps ~1.4x more than the neutral position

maeo2021_seated_leg_curl.title: Greater Hamstrings Muscle Hypertrophy but Similar Damage Protection after Training at Long versus Short Muscle Lengths
maeo2021_seated_leg_curl.authors: Maeo S, Huang M, Wu Y, Sakurai H, Kusagawa Y, Sugiyama T, Kanehisa H, Isaka T
maeo2021_seated_leg_curl.design: within-subject RCT, seated vs prone leg curl, 12 wk, MRI muscle volume
maeo2021_seated_leg_curl.finding: seated (hip-flexed) leg curl grew the whole hamstrings more than prone (+14% vs +9%); both grew

kinoshita2023_standing_calf.title: Triceps surae muscle hypertrophy is greater after standing versus seated calf-raise training
kinoshita2023_standing_calf.authors: Kinoshita M, Maeo S, Kobayashi Y, Eihara Y, Ono M, Sato M, Sugiyama T, Kanehisa H, Isaka T
kinoshita2023_standing_calf.design: within-subject RCT, standing vs seated calf raise, 12 wk, MRI muscle volume
kinoshita2023_standing_calf.finding: standing grew the gastrocnemius far more than seated (seated gastrocnemius did not grow significantly); soleus grew similarly in both

kassiano2023_calf_long_length.title: Greater Gastrocnemius Muscle Hypertrophy After Partial Range of Motion Training Performed at Long Muscle Lengths
kassiano2023_calf_long_length.authors: Kassiano W, Costa B, Kunevaliki G, Soares D, Zacarias G, Manske I, Takaki Y, Ruggiero MF, Stavinski N, Francsuel J, Tricoli I, Carneiro MAS, Cyrino ES
kassiano2023_calf_long_length.design: RCT, calf raise on a leg-press machine, full vs initial (stretched) vs final partial ROM
kassiano2023_calf_long_length.finding: the stretched-position partial grew the medial gastrocnemius more than full or shortened-position ROM

kubo2019_squat_depth.title: Effects of squat training with different depths on lower limb muscle volumes
kubo2019_squat_depth.authors: Kubo K, Ikebukuro T, Yata H
kubo2019_squat_depth.design: RCT, full vs half squat, 10 wk, MRI muscle volume
kubo2019_squat_depth.finding: knee extensors grew similarly; adductors and gluteus maximus grew more with the full squat; rectus femoris and hamstrings did not grow in either

plotkin2023_hip_thrust_vs_squat.title: Hip thrust and back squat training elicit similar gluteus muscle hypertrophy and transfer similarly to the deadlift
plotkin2023_hip_thrust_vs_squat.authors: Plotkin DL, Rodas MA, Vigotsky AD, McIntosh MC, Breeze E, Ubrik R, Robitzsch C, Agyin-Birikorang A, Mattingly ML, Michel JM, Kontos NJ, Lennon S, Fruge AD, Wilburn CM, Weimar WH, Bashir A, Beyers RJ, Henselmans M, Contreras BM, Roberts MD
plotkin2023_hip_thrust_vs_squat.design: RCT, hip thrust vs back squat, 9 wk, MRI
plotkin2023_hip_thrust_vs_squat.finding: similar gluteal hypertrophy; greater thigh (quadriceps/adductor) hypertrophy with the squat

ema2013_knee_extension.title: Inhomogeneous architectural changes of the quadriceps femoris induced by resistance training
ema2013_knee_extension.authors: Ema R, Wakahara T, Miyamoto N, Kanehisa H, Kawakami Y
ema2013_knee_extension.design: 12-wk knee-extension training, MRI + ultrasound per quadriceps muscle
ema2013_knee_extension.finding: knee-extension training grew the rectus femoris relatively more than the vasti

pedrosa2022_long_length_partials.title: Partial range of motion training elicits favorable improvements in muscular adaptations when carried out at long muscle lengths
pedrosa2022_long_length_partials.authors: Pedrosa GF, Lima FV, Schoenfeld BJ, Lacerda LT, Simoes MG, Pereira MR, Diniz RC, Chagas MH
pedrosa2022_long_length_partials.design: RCT, knee extension, initial (stretched) vs final vs full vs varied ROM
pedrosa2022_long_length_partials.finding: partial ROM in the initial (lengthened) phase of the knee extension gave the greatest regional quadriceps growth

sato2021_elbow_angle.title: Elbow Joint Angles in Elbow Flexor Unilateral Resistance Exercise Training Determine Its Effects on Muscle Strength and Thickness of Trained and Non-trained Arms
sato2021_elbow_angle.authors: Sato S, Yoshida R, Kiyono R, Yahata K, Yasaka K, Nunes JP, Nosaka K, et al. (8 authors)
sato2021_elbow_angle.design: RCT, preacher-style curl in the extended (0-50 deg) vs flexed (80-130 deg) elbow range, 5 wk, untrained
sato2021_elbow_angle.finding: the extended (lengthened) range grew elbow-flexor thickness more (8.9% vs 3.4%)

bourne2017_hip_extension_nordic.title: Impact of the Nordic hamstring and hip extension exercises on hamstring architecture and morphology: implications for injury prevention
bourne2017_hip_extension_nordic.authors: Bourne MN, Duhig SJ, Timmins RG, Williams MD, Opar DA, Al Najjar A, Kerr GK, Shield AJ
bourne2017_hip_extension_nordic.design: RCT, Nordic vs hip extension (back-extension style) training, 10 wk, MRI
bourne2017_hip_extension_nordic.finding: hip extension grew the biceps femoris long head more than the Nordic; both grew the semitendinosus

stasinaki2018_triceps_length.title: Triceps Brachii Muscle Strength and Architectural Adaptations with Resistance Training Exercises at Short or Long Fascicle Length
stasinaki2018_triceps_length.authors: Stasinaki AN, Zaras N, Methenitis S, Tsitkanou S, Krase A, Kavvoura A, Terzis G
stasinaki2018_triceps_length.journal: Journal of Functional Morphology and Kinesiology 3:28
stasinaki2018_triceps_length.design: triceps training at long vs short fascicle length (overhead vs other arm positions)
stasinaki2018_triceps_length.finding: registered as existing (DOI resolved via Crossref; not indexed in PubMed); its findings were NOT reviewed, so it backs no tier

haugen2023_free_vs_machine.title: Effect of free-weight vs. machine-based strength training on maximal strength, hypertrophy and jump performance - a systematic review and meta-analysis
haugen2023_free_vs_machine.authors: Haugen ME, Varvik FT, Larsen S, Haugen AS, van den Tillaar R, Bjornsen T
haugen2023_free_vs_machine.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation 15:103
haugen2023_free_vs_machine.finding: no difference in hypertrophy between free-weight and machine training (context, not a per-movement tier)

schoenfeld2017_volume.title: Dose-response relationship between weekly resistance training volume and increases in muscle mass: A systematic review and meta-analysis
schoenfeld2017_volume.authors: Schoenfeld BJ, Ogborn D, Krieger JW
schoenfeld2017_volume.finding: weekly set volume is dose-dependent for hypertrophy (context, not a per-movement tier)

wolf2023_partial_rom.title: Partial Vs Full Range of Motion Resistance Training: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
wolf2023_partial_rom.authors: Wolf M, Androulakis-Korakakis P, Fisher J, Schoenfeld B, Steele J
wolf2023_partial_rom.journal: International Journal of Strength and Conditioning 3(1)
wolf2023_partial_rom.finding: registered as existing (DOI resolved via Crossref; not indexed in PubMed); its findings were NOT reviewed, so it backs no tier

lake2012_kettlebell_swing.title: Kettlebell Swing Training Improves Maximal and Explosive Strength
lake2012_kettlebell_swing.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research 26:2228-2233
lake2012_kettlebell_swing.design: RCT, 6 wk kettlebell swing vs jump squat
lake2012_kettlebell_swing.finding: swing training raised maximal and explosive strength comparably to jump squats (a strength/power outcome — NOT a hypertrophy tier)

clinical_cue_breathing.provenance: owner direction 2026-11-11: clinical context is cues only
